notes.title: Welcome to LucID
notes.content:
# Welcome to LucID

LucID is a modern, privacy-focused note-taking application featuring client-side **AES-256-GCM End-to-End Encryption (E2EE)**.

## Key Capabilities
- 🔒 **Client-Side E2EE**: Your master passphrase encrypts all note titles and contents locally in your browser before storage.
- ↕️↔️ **Dual Split View**: Easily toggle between Side-by-Side (Left/Right) and Top-Bottom split views.
- ☀️🌙 **Theme Engine**: Dusk Ember (Dark) and Warm Linen (Light) themes.
- 📁🏷️ **Folders & Tags**: Expandable hierarchy with instant search.

To lock your vault and encrypt your notes, click the **Lock Vault** button in the bottom left footer and set your master passphrase.
